title: Ultrahuman pill button
description: A fully round pill button about 140px wide and 37px tall: the cobalt buy button, a white one for photos, a translucent glass one that fills with ink on hover, a solid ink one and a hairline outline. Colour and opacity ease over 275ms.
notes: glass is meant for photos: its text uses foreground, so place it where foreground reads (or under the dark class)
name: ultrahuman-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: the blue buy button · light: white fill, dark text (on photos) ·
glass: translucent white over a photo, turns solid ink on hover ·
ink: solid foreground · outline: hairline border, faint fill on hover

props.name: size
props.description: md: 37px tall (40px on phones), 140px wide at least · lg: 42px tall, 143px wide at least

props.name: onClick
props.description: called on click (only when it renders a button)
